course_name_en: MABB220 – Engineering Mechanics Strength of Materials

learning_outcomes.text: After successful completion of the module, students will be able to reliably calculate the stresses and deformations of rod-shaped elastic components for all types of loads (tension/compression, temperature, bending, shear force, torsion) and apply the acquired knowledge to safely, functionally, and economically dimension mechanical components.
Students will also be able to analyze the strength behavior of components under combined stress, identify buckling-prone rods, and evaluate their stability behavior.

syllabus_topics: Calculation of stresses and deformations under tension/compression load
